ndvi.name: Vegetation Cover (NDVI)
ndvi.desc: Measures vegetation density, vigor, and greenness — higher values indicate denser, healthier crops.
ndvi.scientificNote: Tracks double-season Nile Delta crop vigor (winter wheat/berseem and summer rice/maize), reclamation greening, and stress.

lst.name: Land Surface Temperature (LST)
lst.desc: Measures the radiative skin temperature of the land surface itself (distinct from air temperature), observed day and night.
lst.scientificNote: MODIS MOD11C3.061 (0.05° CMG, 2000–2024) captures Daytime (~10:30 LT) heating, Nighttime (~22:30 LT) cooling, and Day–Night thermal spread.
